title: The vocabulary table
description: One hand-written table describing every chain and asset this library may name. Compiled into `specs/schema/asset.schema.json`, `src/chainlens/vocabulary/_generated.py` and `lean/Chainlens/Vocabulary.lean` by `tools/gen_vocabulary.py`. Nothing reads this file at runtime: it is the declared shape, and the generator's refusals are what enforce it.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the shape of a row changes. The generator refuses a version it does not know rather than guessing at a newer one.

assets.description: One row per (chain, asset) pair. The order is the order the dimension basis is written in, so reordering it permutes every exponent vector at once and is a change to the calculus rather than a tidy-up.

id.description: The row's identity, and what appears on the wire where a symbol would. Lowercase, because a symbol is a display convention and two chains may share one.

chain.description: A member of `chainlens.models.enums.Chain`. Closed, and checked by the generator against the enum rather than restated from it.

symbol.description: The ticker a person writes. Not an identity: testnet bitcoin and mainnet bitcoin both render as BTC.

decimals.description: How many decimal places one whole unit has. **This is the number the whole table exists to hold once.** The codec, the adapters, the asset reference and Lean read it from here; none restates it.

families.description: The address families *this library* can validate for the chain, not every family the chain has used. Empty is refused: a row with no family would claim an asset whose addresses cannot be checked at all, which is a provider rather than a coin.

note.description: Optional prose. Carried into the Python row and the Lean row, so a reader of either finds the same qualification.
